'''Sarin Hoigan''' is [[Warder]] to [[Nisao Dachen]].  

== Appearance ==
He is a stump of a man, 5'9" or 175&nbsp;cm in height, but very wide. {{ref/book|10|16}} He is bald, with a thick, black beard.

== Activities ==
He is present when [[Egwene al'Vere]] is dressing down Nisao and [[Myrelle Berengari]] for hiding [[Lan Mandragoran]] in [[Salidar]]. He is on edge watching Lan practice with the sword and picking up Nisao's somber mood.

He is one of the Warders that accompany Egwene and Nisao when they survey the area around [[Tar Valon]].{{ref/book|10|16}}
